The nominal 0-200 m source-defined layer is physically non-equivalent between the approximately 231 m AEON2 and approximately 189 m AEON3 sites. The contract preserves this as domain shift and prohibits a post-outcome depth repair.
Both external archives carry source-reported serial 55146 and share the publisher conditioning chain; they are not two instrument-independent replications.

The target remains source-reported conditioned Sv. Exact raw, firmware configuration, ECS, calibration-certificate and timezone lineage remain unresolved, so absolute-backscatter and biological claims remain prohibited.

The original direct and EMA three-seed ensembles, checkpoint-embedded AEON3 TRAIN scalers, equal averaging and quantile rearrangement are frozen. External fitting, site offsets, normalization, recalibration, model selection and checkpoint substitution are prohibited.

Stage 1 metadata candidates are distinct from Stage 2 numeric-QC issuance. A candidate requires its 24 predecessor IDs and keeps cutoff plus six within the archive interval range, but a missing future horizon row cannot exclude it. Stage 2 may issue only candidates with 24 valid past 38 kHz values, masks invalid other past channels, never filters issuance on future values or availability, and preserves every non-issuance reason.

The 18-anchor daily floor, 90-date per-horizon per-archive gate, common model support, raw five-quantile daily pinball metric, two-source-date paired bootstrap, 2,000 draws, new seed 20260928 and 5-percent/paired-interval/per-horizon gates are fixed before row-level access.
